title: Save-time apiInput cache mirror resolves data path only against project_root, diverging from the cache-build resolution for nested pipelines — committed/ is silently never promoted
description: `_mirror_api_input_caches` resolves each apiInput data file as `data_path = (self._root / path).resolve()` (project_root only). It then calls `mirror_cache_to_committed(str(data_path))`, whose first gate is `_is_working_consulted(data_path)` — a check keyed by `_path_hash` = SHA-256 of the canonical resolved path. The cache *build* path (`routes/json_cache.py::_resolve_data_path`) resolves the SAME logical apiInput path via `resolve_runtime_file_path(path, pipeline_dir=pipeline_dir(), project_root=Path.cwd(), prefer='project', enforce_project_root=True)`, which falls back to the *pipeline-relative* location when the project-root candidate does not exist, and marks THAT resolved path consulted via `_mark_working_consulted`. For a nested pipeline (`pipeline_root != project_root`, a first-class supported config — see `__init__` validating `pipeline_root.is_relative_to(project_root)`, and `pipeline_dir()` returning the configured `[project].pipeline` parent) whose apiInput references a data file relatively (e.g. `path='data/quotes.json'`) that physically lives under the pipeline directory (`<pipeline_root>/data/quotes.json`) and NOT under the project root, the two resolutions diverge: build resolves to `<pipeline_root>/data/quotes.json`; mirror resolves to `<root>/data/quotes.json`. Different paths -> different `_path_hash` -> `_is_working_consulted` returns False for the mirror's hash -> `mirror_cache_to_committed` short-circuits to a no-op (returns False). Result: the working cache the editor built is never promoted to committed/, so the committed/deployed pipeline serves a stale or missing cache while the editor shows the fresh one. The failure is silent (no warning — the mirror simply no-ops the consulted-gate).
evidence: _save_pipeline.py:620-627: `path = cfg.get('path',''); ... data_path = (self._root / path).resolve(); ... mirror_cache_to_committed(str(data_path))`. _json_flatten.py:84-91 `_path_hash` hashes `Path(data_path).expanduser().resolve()`; :111-113 `_is_working_consulted` returns `_path_hash(data_path) in _session_consulted_hashes`; :258-260 mirror returns False when not consulted. json_cache.py:146-159 `_resolve_data_path` uses `resolve_runtime_file_path(..., pipeline_dir=pipeline_dir(), prefer='project')` and the build marks `_mark_working_consulted(data_path)` with that resolved path. _path_resolution.py:101-128 shows the project candidate is tried first but falls back to the pipeline candidate when the project candidate doesn't exist. Existing integration coverage (tests/test_json_cache_integrity.py:196-206) uses `source_file='cache_mirror_pipe.py'` at project root, so `pipeline_root == project_root` and the divergence is never exercised.
